features: 【Perfect Compatibility】Type C to C Cable Compatible with virtually all USB-C devices including phones, tablets, and laptops. Such as MacBook Air/Pro, iPhone 17/17 Air/17 Pro/17 Pro Max, iPhone 16/16 Plus/16 Pro/16 Pro Max, iPhone 15/15 Plus/15 Pro/15 Pro Max, Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra/S24+/S24/S23 Ultra/S23+/S23/S22 Ultra/S22+/S22/S21 Ultra/S21+/S21/S20/ S20+/S20 Ultra/Note 20, Pixel series, iPad Mini 6, iPad Pro, iPad Air, Steam Deck, Switch and more upcoming devices with USB-C port.

【Double Ended USB-C Cable】: This is the USB-C to USB-C Cable. NOT the USB-C to USB-A cable, which means it has the same USB-C charger block on the both ends, so you need a USB-C wall charger to charge your device.
【Durable and Stable】Premium Nylon Braided adding additional durability and tangle-free, can bear 40000+ bending test,resulting in a longer lifespan compared to ordinary Type C to Type C cables.

【Noble TPE &Nylon Braided Cover】TPE & nylon braided outer cover with excellent touch, lightweight, stability, durability, longevity, anti-aging, strong bending strength and impact toughness, the smooth surface and bright color make our charging cable with high-end and exquisite feeling,also TPE with anti conductive and anti static functions, high flame retardancy, can protect your device, and also protect people from static radiation

【Fast Charge & Data Transfer】It allows for a maximum charging speed of 60W 20V 3A and supports high-speed data sync at 480Mbps.For our USBC to USBC cable,you may need a type c to type c wall charger to charge your device
